_doc: Named Colab runs for colab/dcad.py. data: dataset names (Drive: dcad/datasets/<name>.tar); clean_blue_per_task: N clean sim demos per blue task (first N of sim_blue_v2c_24); phone: 'all' | 'blue' (phone_v2 replays, all tasks or blue only); ambient: true adds --ambient_t_min defaults.ambient_t_min (chosen from the small-policy sweep; null = not chosen yet, ambient runs refuse to start); train: extra train_smolvla.py args (added to defaults.train); probe: extra probe args; eval_k: episodes/task for the final eval (0 = skip); eval_steps: checkpoints to evaluate (default: the latest); init_from: continue another run's latest checkpoint (weights + optimizer). Add a new entry per experiment; never edit one that has run (its checkpoints on Drive were made with those args).
